description: Overlay plus every tool window. Every window label must match something here — a window that is absent gets no permissions at all, so window.__TAURI__.opener is never injected and tauriBridge.js dies on its first destructure, leaving a blank window. details-* covers the per-fight windows, which are labelled by fight id; pw_* covers plugin widgets (pw_<plugin>_<widget>). dashboard is the window holding the bundled plugins (plugins/bundled.rs); overlay holds every plugin's widgets (plugins/overlay.rs).
